games.title: Daily Word Search
games.tagline: Find the hidden words before the clock runs out.
games.description: A free daily word search puzzle. Every player gets the same 10x10 grid, the clock starts at 100 seconds, and your score is based on the words you find and how fast you find them. Free to play, no download.
howToPlay: Drag across a straight line of letters - horizontal, vertical or diagonal.
Release to submit the word. Correct words stay highlighted in colour.
You have 100 seconds. Longer words and faster finds are worth more points.
A new grid is generated every day and everyone plays the same one.

faq.q: Is the daily word search free?
faq.a: Yes. Every game on arcadefork is free to play in your browser. There is no account, no download and no paywall.

faq.q: Do I get a new puzzle every day?
faq.a: Yes. The grid is generated from the date, so every player worldwide gets exactly the same puzzle, and it changes at midnight UTC.

faq.q: How is the score calculated?
faq.a: Each word is worth 60 points plus 20 per letter, doubled by the seconds still left on the clock when you find it.

faq.q: Can I play on a phone?
faq.a: Yes. The game is built mobile first - drag with your finger, and it works in portrait or landscape.

games.title: 2048 Merge
games.tagline: Slide the tiles, merge the numbers, chase 2048.
games.description: A free 2048 style number merge game. Slide tiles in four directions, merge matching numbers, and try to reach the 2048 tile. Play instantly in your browser on mobile or desktop.
howToPlay: Swipe in a direction, or use the arrow keys, to slide every tile.
Two tiles with the same number merge into one tile worth double.
A new tile appears after each move, so keep the board open.
The run ends when there are no moves left.

faq.q: How do I play 2048?
faq.a: Swipe or press an arrow key to slide all tiles in that direction. Matching tiles merge into a single tile with double the value. Keep sliding until you reach 2048.

faq.q: Is 2048 free on arcadefork?
faq.a: Yes, completely free with no sign-up. Your best score is saved locally on your device.

faq.q: Can I play 2048 on my phone?
faq.a: Yes. Swipe to move, or tap the on-screen arrow buttons. The game fits any screen size.

games.title: Neon Snake
games.tagline: Classic snake, rebuilt for the browser.
games.description: A free neon snake game. Guide the snake, eat the orbs, and grow as long as you can. The edges wrap around so one mistake is never the end.
howToPlay: Swipe or use the arrow keys to steer the snake.
Eat the glowing orbs to score 10 points and grow longer.
The board wraps at the edges, so you never die on a wall.
Running into your own tail ends the run.

faq.q: How do I control the snake?
faq.a: Swipe in any direction on touch screens, or use the arrow keys or WASD on desktop. Turns are queued so fast double turns register.

faq.q: Does the snake die at the wall?
faq.a: No. The edges wrap around, which keeps runs long. The only way to lose is to run into your own tail.

faq.q: Is Neon Snake free?
faq.a: Yes, free to play in the browser with no install. Your best score is stored on your device.

games.title: Memory Match
games.tagline: Find the matching pairs before the clock gets silly.
games.description: A free memory match game. Flip two cards, remember where the pairs hide, and clear the board in as few moves as possible. Play free in your browser on mobile or desktop.
howToPlay: Tap a card to flip it over.
Tap a second card. If they match, both stay revealed.
If they do not match, they turn back over - remember where they were.
Clear every pair in as few moves as you can.

faq.q: How do I play memory match?
faq.a: Tap one card to flip it, then tap a second. Matching pairs stay face up, mismatched pairs flip back after a moment. Clear the whole board in the fewest moves.

faq.q: Is Memory Match free on arcadefork?
faq.a: Yes - completely free, no account and no download. Your best score is saved on your device.

faq.q: How many cards are in the game?
faq.a: A 4x4 board of 16 cards on normal difficulty. Try easy or hard mode with the difficulty switch to change the board size.

games.title: Tetris
games.tagline: The block-stacking classic, in your browser.
games.description: Free Tetris. Stack falling blocks, clear four lines at a time and chase a high score. The original Javascript Tetris by Jake Gordon, running in your browser with no download and no sign-up.
howToPlay: Use the arrow keys to move and rotate the falling block.
Fill a row completely to clear it and score points.
Stacked blocks that reach the top end the game.
Play with the on-screen controls on a touch screen.

faq.q: How do I play Tetris?
faq.a: Left and right arrows move the falling block, up arrow rotates it and down arrow drops it faster. Complete a horizontal row of blocks to clear it.

faq.q: Is this Tetris free?
faq.a: Yes. It runs entirely in your browser with no download, no account and no payment.

faq.q: Who made this version of Tetris?
faq.a: Javascript Tetris by Jake Gordon, open sourced under the MIT licence. See the credits page for details.

games.title: Pacman
games.tagline: Maze, pellets, ghosts. The chase is on.
games.description: Free Pacman in your browser. Eat the pellets, dodge the ghosts and clear the maze. An open-source Pacman by mumuy, playable instantly with no download and no sign-up.
howToPlay: Use the arrow keys or WASD to steer Pacman around the maze.
Eat the pellets to clear the level.
The ghosts get faster as you go - power pellets let you eat them.
Three lives. Keep them as long as you can.

faq.q: How do I play Pacman?
faq.a: Steer with the arrow keys or WASD, and on mobile with the on-screen controls. Eat the small pellets to clear the maze and avoid the ghosts.

faq.q: Is Pacman free to play?
faq.a: Yes, free in the browser with no download or sign-up. It is an open-source Pacman by mumuy, MIT licensed.

faq.q: Does this work on a phone?
faq.a: Yes. The game scales to the screen and includes touch controls.

games.title: The Evolution of Trust
games.tagline: A game about trust, betrayal and copycats.
games.description: Free online game about trust. Play as the copycat, the always-cooperator or the cheater and learn how repeated interactions create cooperation, grudges and karma. No download, no sign-up.
howToPlay: Pick a character - copycat, always-cooperate, always-cheat, grudger, detective or copykitten.
Play a round against the other players and try to score the most.
Change one rule at a time and watch how the whole system reacts.
The point of the game is the experiment, not the score.

faq.q: What is The Evolution of Trust?
faq.a: An interactive explanation of how trust and cooperation emerge in repeated games. You play rounds against different strategies and change the rules to see what changes.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes. It is public domain (CC0) by Nicky Case and runs in your browser with no download, no sign-up and no ads.

faq.q: Who created it?
faq.a: Nicky Case, the creator of We Become What We Behold and Loopy. See the credits page.

games.title: Loopy
games.tagline: A tiny tool for thinking in systems.
games.description: Free interactive tool for thinking in systems. Draw a loop, set how it behaves and see what it does over time. By Nicky Case, public domain, runs in your browser with no download.
howToPlay: Drag on the grid to draw a loop.
Place nodes on the loop and set what each one does - grow, shrink or split.
Press play and watch the system evolve.
Change one variable at a time to build intuition for feedback loops.

faq.q: What is Loopy?
faq.a: A minimal interactive tool for building intuition about feedback loops and system dynamics. You draw a loop, assign behaviour to each node, and run it.

faq.q: Is Loopy free?
faq.a: Yes. It is public domain (CC0) by Nicky Case and runs in your browser with no download or sign-up.

faq.q: Does it work on a phone?
faq.a: Yes, though a larger screen makes drawing loops much easier.
